free.question: Is Lumivox free to use?
free.answer: Yes - the Starter plan is free forever and includes tasks, the focus timer, four ambient rooms and weekly analytics.

coach.question: How does the AI coach work?
coach.answer: It quietly observes your focus sessions, completions and break patterns, then recommends what to study next, ideal session length, and when to rest.

privacy.question: Is my data private?
privacy.answer: Your behavioral data is yours. We never sell it, and you can export or delete everything from settings at any time.

friends.question: Can I study with friends?
friends.answer: Yes - join themed study rooms, see live presence, and use light reactions. Group rooms come with Campus plans.

cta.title: Make your next study session your best one.
cta.subtitle: Join thousands of students using Lumivox to focus deeper, plan smarter, and finally feel proud of their week.

footer.description: Calm intelligence for your study - behavioral analytics and AI recommendations for the next generation of learners.
